Carlos — thanks for the clear list. High level answer up front: we log user/admin auth events, role/permission changes, console actions (create/delete/update on customer-managed objects), API key lifecycle events, and operator-level session start/stop along with KV cache invalidation and model variant roll events. Retention differs by event class; by default admin activity is retained 90 days in the hot store and a 2-year cold archive for enterprise customers.

Below is a concise checklist and the export options. I’ve looped in Karthik (infra exports) and Soojin (compliance proofs).

Quick checklist (what we will provide):
- Event classes: auth, auth_failure, role_change, api_key_rotate, model_deploy, config_change, operator_session, token_issue, token_revoke
- Base schema fields: timestamp (RFC3339), actor_id, actor_email, actor_role, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, ip_address, region, request_payload_summary
- PII handling: email is hashed and salted in exports on request; raw email included only under signed NDA export flows
- Retention: 90 days (hot, queryable), 2 years (cold, compressed snapshots) for enterprise plans; otherwise 30d/90d tiers depending on契約

Export methods and expected lead times:
- SFTP drop (encrypted tarball with manifest + SHA256 checksums): 48–72 hours to provision and deliver for on-demand pulls
- Presigned S3 links (short-lived, limited window): available within 24 hours for automated pulls; we provide a signed manifest and checksum file
- Push to customer S3/GCS via dedicated pipeline (requires onboarding): 5 business days for initial setup
- Live streaming export (for continuous mirroring): available for Dedicated/Private with partner integration; requires config and contract addendum

Sample artifacts we’ll attach to this thread: redwood_export_manifest_template.csv (manifest columns + checksum rules) and a compressed one-day sample: sample_admin_snapshot-20260908.jsonl.gz (schema only, no real PII).

Let me know if you want the sample with unhashed emails (that needs an executed DPA & POA), or if the auditor prefers a different schema ordering.

Elizabeth/Carlos — yes to both. Details below and next steps: 

SFTP deliverable format (standard):
- File layout: redwood_evidence/YYYY/MM/DD/admin-events-YYYYMMDD.jsonl.gz
- Daily file per UTC calendar day; cutoff = 00:00 UTC; files are rolled at 00:05 UTC and checksummed immediately
- Manifest: redwood_evidence/YYYY/MM/DD/manifest-YYYYMMDD.csv (columns: filename,SHA256,record_count,compressed_size)
- Top-level signed manifest: redwood_evidence/YYYY/MM/DD/signed_manifest-YYYYMMDD.json.sig (signed by Redwood KMS; we provide verification instructions)
- Delivery SLA: first-time provisioning 48–72 hours; monthly scheduled runs available after setup

On the sample: attached sample_admin_snapshot-20260908.jsonl.gz is a one-day sample (schema-only, synthetic guids, no customer PII). Manifest template attached as redwood_export_manifest_template.csv.

1) We open a provisioning ticket with infra (CC: Karthik).

5) Handover: Soojin will provide signed manifest verification steps and ingest notes.
